signatures.description: Given a function in SSA form with liveness and interference already computed over machine basic blocks, implement spill-slot allocation that coalesces non-interfering spilled values to shrink the frame. The allocator must never merge a value live across a loop back-edge with a value defined only on that back-edge critical path, and must emit the concrete interference witness for every rejection. Report frame-size savings versus naive one-slot-per-value on a function with nested loops and a register-pressure cliff.
